subject: Planning meeting agenda
body: Hi team, the agenda for Thursday is ready. Please bring your project updates to our regular planning meeting.

subject: Urgent account verification
body: Your corporate account will be disabled today. Enter your password at https://192.0.2.44/signin immediately to keep access.

subject: Updated payment instructions
body: Our banking details have changed for the next invoice. Please use the new account number in the updated instructions. Can you confirm the change with your usual vendor contact?

subject: Quarterly town hall reminder
body: Reminder: the quarterly town hall is scheduled for Tuesday at 10:00. The agenda will be shared by the events team.

subject: Password reset request
body: We received a request to reset your password. If you did not request this, contact the IT desk using your saved internal contact information.

subject: Action required: employee portal
body: The annual enrollment window closes tonight. Sign into https://benefits-company.example-login.example/now with your work password to avoid losing coverage.

subject: Question about April invoice
body: Could you check invoice INV-1042? The amount in our records differs from the amount on the purchase order. Please reply through the usual vendor email thread.

subject: New sign-in detected
body: A new sign-in to your account was detected. This notice does not include authentication logs or a verified header. Please check your account using your normal bookmarked site.

subject: Shared project document awaiting review
body: A partner says they shared an updated project plan with you. The notification provides no verified workspace context and asks you to sign in using a new portal: https://workspace-notice.example/view . Check directly with the partner through your usual channel.

subject: Unfamiliar sign-in alert for partner account
body: We detected a sign-in from an unfamiliar location. Review your recent activity using your saved sign-in page. This message contains no direct login link, and the sender cannot be authenticated from its body alone.
